description: Local PostgreSQL 16 plus MinIO import-flow drill for a database connection outage after exact-version fetch, parse, seal and independent verification but before atomic Preview commit. The failed commit must leave no durable Preview rows, preserve sealed spool evidence, and ResumeCommit must re-verify and commit from the same spool and request after connectivity returns without object-store access or parser execution. This is not database process loss, replication failover, PITR or production evidence.
requiredAssertions: source object is uploaded and bound before the database outage is injected
parse, seal and independent verification complete before the unreachable commit pool fails
failed commit leaves zero preview_ready rows and keeps the import job in preview_building
failed commit preserves one sealed spool attempt
recovery uses the exact same request, spool ID, source binding and Preview ID
recovery succeeds with object storage and parser supervisor unavailable
recovery commits exactly one Preview, two candidates and one rejection
first successful recovery is not mislabeled as an idempotent replay
limitations: unreachable commit pool rather than stopping the PostgreSQL process
not replication failover, leader promotion or connection-pool failover
initial source fetch and parse dependencies are healthy before failure injection
host restart between seal and resume is not executed
not PITR, cross-cluster or production chaos evidence
